Episode 148. Sword Emperor (7)

As Dante's vitality was slowly returning, something warm surged up in Ron's heart. Although his mind was becoming numb due to the energy of Changseong, he couldn't hide his emotion, and his eyes moistened.
The amount of chaos escaping through the defensive wall was also significantly decreasing. The speed at which Ron's swordsmanship was tearing Gliack apart also increased.
Gliack, who had effortlessly dominated the world's strongest families' first army, was nowhere to be found now.
Squelch, rip-!
The figure Ron had forcibly assembled was being sliced every second. While Gliack's momentum was rapidly declining, Ron's sword was increasingly showing its true power.
Gliack's screams were getting smaller. It was not because the pain had lessened, but because his energy had weakened.
The black vortex of chaos that had eroded the sky was also shrinking. Jin was finally able to reach Rosa and Talaris as his influence decreased.
"Youngest."
Rosa said, wiping the blood from her lips. They looked into each other's eyes in silence for a moment.
Jin didn't thank Rosa for rushing to save him, and Rosa didn't expect him to. They had simply done what they had to do.

After briefly bowing to Rosa, Jin turned his gaze to Talaris. As soon as he saw her, he immediately realized something. If Rosa had continued to enter the battlefield to save him, Talaris might already be dead.
Asking Talaris to seal Dante was too much. She was barely able to control her own body now. Fortunately, since Dante was reviving, it seemed that it wouldn't be a big problem without Talaris's help.
But Rosa's expression, as she examined Dante's body, wasn't good.
"He's alive, but in his current state, it's as if he's dead as a warrior."
"What do you mean?"
"…His entire body's blood flow is blocked, and the entire aura operation organ, including the danjeon, is fatally damaged. Didn't you know?"
He had been running mindlessly, so he hadn't had time to notice.
Upon checking, it turned out as Rosa said. Unless it was the tears of Numerus, which could bring even the dead back to life, it seemed impossible to return.
Jin closed his eyes tightly and swallowed a sigh.
"As long as he's alive, that's enough. Just the fact that he's not dead... is enough for me."
"I hope Lord Ron and Dante Highran feel the same way."
"Kid, are you okay!"
At Murakan's voice, Jin nodded his head. He still wanted to escape with Jin right then, but Jin refused his intention.
"It's impossible to break through that barrier of chaos and Lord Ron. Besides, even if it were possible, leaving now would only invite danger."
This meant that if Jin and Murakan could leave the battlefield with their powers, so could Kelliak and Rosa.
'If that happens, Kelliak will chase after Dante and me. Even if the family somehow manages to shake them off, it's just as dangerous for my mother to face Kelliak.'
Now, Kelliak had to secure both Jin and Dante. Jin was needed for the completion of the Demon Stone, and Dante was needed to be held hostage to prevent Ron from recklessly attacking in the future.
The same was true if only Rosa remained.
She doesn't cherish Dante like Jin. Just like Kelliak, to her, Dante was nothing more than a card to move Ron Highran. Jin and Murakan currently did not have the power to protect Dante from them.
So, Jin had to make sure that Dante completely returned to Ron's side after the war. It was a matter of duty as a friend and responsibility as a human.
Grrrrrr……!
The physical form of Gliack, which was being forcibly shaped, was writhing.
Everything he planned after waking up from the seal was turning into failure. It meant that the fate that had already been set was changing.
Despite being sealed for such a long time, he had to be extinguished so futilely. For Gliack, it was an utterly unacceptable situation.
What on earth is the reason Ron doesn't fall into the abyss?
While his body was being torn apart, Gliack naturally thought about the cause. The power of Changseong he knew could never stabilize this quickly.
Soon, Gliack came to a conclusion.
[You… The moment you touched Changseong, you shared its energy with the contractor of Soldoret. Yes, that's how you were able to withstand the demonization.]
"Listening to a monster speak human language is getting on my nerves."
[Why did you do that?]
"For reasons you wouldn't understand."
[Don't you regret it?]
"Of course."
[You are a special human. Even combining hundreds and millions of mortals cannot surpass the value of the power you have.]
"So you are being extinguished by me."
[Huhuhuhu……!]
Gliack let out a laugh mixed with self-mockery.
He admitted that he could not defeat Ron. However, it wasn't that he didn't have a single means to make a last-ditch effort.
[Self-destruction was supposed to be my role.]
Ron narrowed his eyes.
He hadn't considered the case where he would self-destruct with Gliack. Because even if he saved Dante, if he died, he wouldn't be able to protect him in the future.
That's why he was rather wary of Gliack self-destructing. If the massive chaos that forms him explodes all at once, even he can't guarantee anything.
Suddenly, the wind of chaos stopped moving. At the sight of the chaos devouring the earth and sky all at once stopping, the humans felt a foreboding feeling creeping in.
Like streams gathering into the sea, the paused chaos started to converge in the middle of the battlefield. Ron tried to grasp this flow, but its energy did not stop.
Choose, Ron Highran.
About ten seconds later, Gliack's voice echoed across the battlefield again.
What he demanded was nothing else but a choice.
[You can surely get out of this alone. Whether you protect yourself or save the mortals who are worthless compared to you, I will watch until the end. With pleasure…….]
For Gliack, it was the best judgment and the last remaining move.

Once he had shared the light of Changseong with Jin, Ron could never completely block his self-destruction. Even if he did block it, he would either die or become unable to fight, so he had to do this for his brothers beyond Mt. Tigris in the future.
It wasn't too bad even if Ron fled alone. The fact that he abandoned his blood kin, whom he so desperately wanted to protect, would amplify his abyss again.
At that moment, Dante got up.
"Dante!"
He was regaining vitality, but he wasn't fully able to move yet.
However, like Ron, who had overcome death, he was moving towards his grandfather.
"I can't… let you, grandfather……."
Ron turned to look at the direction where his grandson was running.
Watching his grandson running towards him with a broken and battered body, Ron smiled.

He didn't even tell him to back off because all of Gliack's chaos would explode soon. Instead, he created a path with light so his grandson could approach him directly. The wind of Changseong was assisting Dante's steps.
"Come closer, Dante."
Blood tears were streaming from Dante's eyes as he approached Ron.
Thud…….
Soon Dante collapsed and arrived in Ron's arms.
After patting his grandson's back several times, Ron grabbed his shoulders and lifted him up.
"Dante Highran, my grandson."
"Grandfather, Gra, Grandpa……."
"I intended to give you everything anyway. The time just had to be moved up a bit unavoidably. From the moment you were born, my life was yours."
Dante couldn't speak.
He couldn't bear the choke in his throat due to the intuition that this was indeed the last moment with his grandfather, and the conviction that his grandfather would never change his choice.
"Having fought while being in pain the whole time, I understand how hard it must have been for you."
Ron handed his sword, Rashid, to Dante.
Dante kept shaking his head, locking eyes with Ron, but Ron's hand, holding his own hand that held Rashid, was incredibly firm.
And it was warm. So warm that he couldn't reject it, even if he wanted to.
You are the Sword Emperor.
You are becoming the Sword Emperor.
At the sound of Ron's following voice, Dante burst into sorrowful tears.
And Dante realized that an incredibly strong vitality was infusing into his body.
The light of Changseong obtained by the human known as Ron Highran, and the true energy obtained by the warrior known as the Sword Emperor, were transferring from him to Dante.
Like sand slipping through the gaps between fingers, not all of that power could be fully transferred to Dante. Just like when he shared the light of Changseong with Jin.
However, it was enough to make Dante's heartbeat race again and for his shattered organs to find their place again.
At the same time, what Dante Highran had had since his birth...
The 'innate chaos' that had made Dante so frail was disappearing. It was a result of the white stone, Gliack, the entity that had created that chaos, beginning to lose its ego.
There was no entity left in the world that could be called Gliack now.
Only a massive chaos, like a volcano about to erupt, filled the battlefield.
"I've always been proud of you."
"Grandpa, please, please stop. You need to survive, not someone like me. If I stay alone……!"
"And since I loved you more than anything in the world, I, as a grandpa, have enjoyed a lot of blessings."
Ron lifted his head and locked eyes with Jin, who had followed Dante.
"Please take care of Dante. I owe you to the end, without giving anything."
Jin couldn't say anything.
Ron hugged Dante for the last time. Feeling his grandson's heart beating strongly, he felt reassured.
"Now go, Dante. This is not the end for you and me, so don't linger in sorrow for too long."
Ron turned around, and Dante and Jin's bodies rose into the air.
Dante struggled and reached out towards Ron, but their bodies were moving away from him along the path of light.
"Grandpa, Grandpa……!"

Only after Dante's voice calling him had completely faded did Ron look back at the path of light from which his grandson had disappeared. He had only looked back now, thinking that he might waver at the sight of his grandson fading away.
Then, forming a sword in place of Rashid.
He moved towards the core of chaos to end the war.
It was the moment when the chaotic fate of Dante's death and Highran's destruction completely changed.
